summary: Before terminal CLOSING capacity failure, one deterministic repair may remove at most three low-priority body leaves and must pass one fresh Chromium capture.
invariants: The reducer applies only to ordinary-profile CLOSING slides and only to browser_body or QID over-capacity.
Source block IDs, semantic roles, capacity limits, title-edge gates, and font floors remain unchanged.
Accept repair only when one fresh Chromium recapture has no capacity violations; otherwise fail nonretryably.
forbidden: Do not relax title, body, image, or supporting roles to satisfy capacity.
Do not retry deterministic residual capacity violations or mutate the database directly.
